title: Pocket Egyptian Arabic
sub: 850+ Essential Phrases & 1,000-Word Dictionary for Travelers to Egypt, with Audio at Normal & Slow Speed
author: Basem Elguoshy Madian

items.en: kh — Like 'ch' in Scottish 'loch' or German 'Bach'
gh — Like a French 'r', soft gargle
H — A strong, breathy 'h' from the throat
3 — A deep sound from the throat — listen to the audio
' — A short stop, like the break in 'uh-oh'
g — Always hard, as in 'go' — never as in 'gem'
r — Rolled or tapped, as in Spanish or Italian

items.ar: تصبح على خير / تصبحي على خير

items.en: This is my first time in Egypt.
